research.note: The unit costs are the market research of 2026-11-09, made at Samuel's request ("make the costs research now"): public web sources, 2023–2026 prices in euros (GBP 1.18, USD 0.87–0.92, CHF 1.07). Its limit: page fetching was blocked where it was made, so every figure comes from search-engine extracts of the cited pages, not full reads; a row with one source is unverified; a row marked an estimate is the researcher's own build-up. Contractor: installed by a contractor. Self-built: materials, the villagers' own labour (structural design, cranes and licensed trades still bought).
